title: Komorebi Cedar Ryokan
description: Set along a quiet moss-lined lane in Kyoto Higashiyama ward, Komorebi blends traditional sugi-cedar joinery with private hinoki soaking tubs overlooking a lantern-lit koi pond.

title: Villa Solaria Cliffside
description: Carved into the limestone terraces above Positano, Villa Solaria offers sun-drenched vaulted suites, private citrus gardens, and panoramic dining terraces above the Tyrrhenian Sea.

title: Kamm Alpine Timber Lodge
description: An intimate ski-in sanctuary in Zermatt framed in charred larch and floor-to-ceiling glazing, featuring wood-burning hearth suites and direct Matterhorn ridge views.

title: Riad Zelligia Courtyard
description: Restored from a 19th-century merchant courtyard in the Marrakech Medina, this serene residence centers on an emerald zellige plunge pool shaded by Seville orange trees.

title: Lyngen Fjord Pavilion
description: Cantilevered over granite shoreline along Norway Aurlandsfjord, Lyngen Pavilion pairs minimalist Nordic oak interiors with private fjord-water sauna decks.

title: Casa do Miradouro House
description: Occupying a sunlit ochre townhouse in Alfama, Casa do Miradouro welcomes travelers with hand-painted azulejo salons and a rooftop terrace overlooking the Tagus River.

title: Ventis Redwood Cliff Retreat
description: Perched high on Big Sur rugged coastal bluffs, Ventis combines salvaged redwood architecture, salt-mist infinity pools, and quiet trails winding through ancient coastal pines.
